系统：替身有编号。原件去向不在节目单里。

music_qizhen_swan_chase.source: Deterministic ffmpeg pursuit bed after MiniMax Music HTTP 410

wake_narration.speaker: narrator
wake_narration.voiceTextEn: You do not have five minutes. Still, the confidence is impressive.
wake_narration.subtitleZh: 你没有5分钟了，但你很有勇气

xy_attack.speaker: system
xy_attack.voiceTextEn: Wait, wait, wait. You are trying to skip class? Absolutely not. I am not letting you check in.
xy_attack.subtitleZh: 等等等等，你想翘课？没门！我不会让你签上的！

xy_laugh.speaker: system
xy_laugh.voiceTextEn: Go find your digits. All four of them. Ha.
xy_laugh.subtitleZh: 找你的数字去吧哈哈哈

sys_balance.speaker: system
sys_balance.subtitleZh: 余额暂时不足以购买尊严

sys_net_try.speaker: system
sys_net_try.subtitleZh: 校园网已经尽力了，你也是

act1_locked_entry.speaker: system
act1_locked_entry.subtitleZh: 很好，你打开了游戏。现在请先去申请操作自己。

act1_identity_verified.speaker: system
act1_identity_verified.subtitleZh: 登录成功。这个角色终于有名字了，仍然没联网。

act1_phone_linked.speaker: system
act1_phone_linked.subtitleZh: 电话接通。用学号当电话号码，很有校园特色。

act1_controls_installed.speaker: system
act1_controls_installed.subtitleZh: 方向键到货。体艺还没批准你走路。

act1_movement_enabled.speaker: system
act1_movement_enabled.subtitleZh: 锻炼开始。恭喜，你现在被允许步行。

act1_required_item_collected.speaker: system
act1_required_item_collected.subtitleZh: 卡带拿到了。继续把地图走完，四个区域一个都不能漏。

act1_map_completed.speaker: system
act1_map_completed.subtitleZh: 全图已刷。游戏菜单已开放，系统已记录你会走路。

prologue_narrator_intro.speaker: narrator
prologue_narrator_intro.voiceTextEn: Pfft, oh, sorry. I did not mean anything by it. It is just... this does not look like a success, does it? I suppose you will have to get up, drag yourself to class, and deal with it. Good luck, kid! I am leaving!
prologue_narrator_intro.subtitleZh: 噗，哦抱歉，我没别的意思，只是……这看起来不像成功了对吧。我想你只好乖乖起来滚去上课了。祝你好运，孩子！我要走了！

prologue_narrator_caught.speaker: narrator
prologue_narrator_caught.voiceTextEn: Hey! What exactly do you think you are doing? Let go of me!
prologue_narrator_caught.subtitleZh: 嘿！你到底在干什么？放开我！

prologue_narrator_bargain.speaker: narrator
prologue_narrator_bargain.voiceTextEn: Oh, fine, fine! But first, take your hand off me!
prologue_narrator_bargain.subtitleZh: 哦，好吧，好吧！但你先把手放开！

act2_system_found_intro.speaker: system
act2_system_found_intro.voiceTextEn: Oh, damn it. You win, kid.

act2_system_inventory_demand.speaker: system
act2_system_inventory_demand.subtitleZh: 行。把你的道具栏拿出来。

act2_system_inventory_missing.speaker: system
act2_system_inventory_missing.voiceTextEn: Wait. Where is your inventory? You cannot expect me to work empty-handed!
act2_system_inventory_missing.subtitleZh: 等等，你的道具栏呢？你总不能指望我空手干活！

act2_system_departure.speaker: system
act2_system_departure.voiceTextEn: You found it. Great. Then let us get moving.
act2_system_departure.subtitleZh: 你找到了，那就太好了，我们出发吧！

act2_system_confession.speaker: system
act2_system_confession.voiceTextEn: I should be honest. I do not have permission to edit attendance records.
act2_system_confession.subtitleZh: 我得说实话了，我没有修改记录权限

act2_system_friend.speaker: system
act2_system_friend.voiceTextEn: But I have a friend who might.
act2_system_friend.subtitleZh: 但我有一个朋友她或许能做到

act2_system_library.speaker: system
act2_system_library.voiceTextEn: If we still want your participation grade, we need to find her in the library.
act2_system_library.subtitleZh: 如果我们还想要平时分，就得去图书馆找她

act2_character_cannot_hear.speaker: system
act2_character_cannot_hear.subtitleZh: 他听不到你说话。现在的他连一个能回应的名字都没有。

act2_character_named.speaker: system
act2_character_named.subtitleZh: 姓名和学号一致。很好，他现在知道自己是谁了。

act2_mentor_line_stuck.speaker: system
act2_mentor_line_stuck.subtitleZh: 那条竖线粘住了。看来导师头像也有自己的排版要求。

act2_right_arrow_assembled.speaker: system
act2_right_arrow_assembled.subtitleZh: 一个三角形加一条竖线。现在你有了一支能把东西向右移的箭头。

act2_balance_shifted.speaker: system
act2_balance_shifted.subtitleZh: 小数点向右移动了两位。六分钱暂时获得了六元钱的尊严。

act2_gamepad_purchase_rejected.speaker: system
act2_gamepad_purchase_rejected.subtitleZh: 你只有零点零六元。卖家拒绝了你分一百期付款的方案。

library_story_library_entered_02.speaker: system
library_story_library_entered_02.subtitleZh: 她最后留下入馆记录的地方。

library_story_library_entered_12.speaker: system
library_story_library_entered_12.subtitleZh: 这张记录没有固定时长。先去闸机核对入馆时间。

library_story_library_occupied_seat_foun.speaker: narrator
library_story_library_occupied_seat_foun.subtitleZh: 022 被一个书包占着，桌上的纸条写着“主人马上回来”。

library_story_library_occupied_seat_foun.speaker: system
library_story_library_occupied_seat_foun.subtitleZh: 先别碰。去 CC98 查三分钟离座的规则。

library_story_cc98_occupation_post_opene.speaker: system
library_story_cc98_occupation_post_opene.subtitleZh: 先看这条讨论，确认三分钟离座的规则。

library_story_cc98_occupation_post_opene.speaker: system
library_story_cc98_occupation_post_opene.subtitleZh: 拿到规则，再补齐恢复 022 的证明。

library_story_library_catalog_match_foun.speaker: narrator
library_story_library_catalog_match_foun.subtitleZh: 书名、索书号和 022 的记录都能对上。

library_story_library_catalog_match_foun.speaker: system
library_story_library_catalog_match_foun.subtitleZh: 去一层书库 755 号书架背面找旧版规则。

library_story_library_archived_rule_reco.speaker: system
library_story_library_archived_rule_reco.subtitleZh: 规则只认已经留下的材料。

library_story_library_archived_rule_reco.speaker: system
library_story_library_archived_rule_reco.subtitleZh: 座位小票、到馆证明、书包非本人证明。

library_story_library_front_desk_proof_r.speaker: system
library_story_library_front_desk_proof_r.subtitleZh: 请先提交书包非本人证明。

library_story_library_front_desk_proof_r.speaker: system
library_story_library_front_desk_proof_r.subtitleZh: 系统里，它目前登记为座位使用者。

library_story_library_bag_nonperson_proo.speaker: system
library_story_library_bag_nonperson_proo.subtitleZh: 盖章完成。书包不再算 022 的使用者。

library_story_library_bag_nonperson_proo.speaker: player
library_story_library_bag_nonperson_proo.subtitleZh: 我今天跑的证明比上课还多。

library_story_tiyi_presence_proof_issued.speaker: system
library_story_tiyi_presence_proof_issued.subtitleZh: 入馆和到馆时间已写入记录。

library_story_tiyi_presence_proof_issued.speaker: player
library_story_tiyi_presence_proof_issued.subtitleZh: 终于有一项证明的是我自己。

library_story_cc98_evidence_set_complete.speaker: player
library_story_cc98_evidence_set_complete.subtitleZh: 好了，证据齐了。现在图书馆会处理了吧？

library_story_cc98_evidence_set_complete.speaker: system
library_story_cc98_evidence_set_complete.subtitleZh: 还差公开确认。图书馆 App 只读取十大帖的四位热度口令。

library_story_cc98_evidence_set_complete.speaker: system
library_story_cc98_evidence_set_complete.subtitleZh: bd 是“帮顶”。在一条数字回复上点 bd，数字就会按顺序写入口令。

library_story_cc98_top_ten_reached_01.speaker: narrator
library_story_cc98_top_ten_reached_01.subtitleZh: 帖子到了第一，022 的恢复申请入口开放。

library_story_library_seat_release_pass_.speaker: player
library_story_library_seat_release_pass_.subtitleZh: 这次该把座位还给人了。

library_story_library_backpack_evicted_0.speaker: system
library_story_library_backpack_evicted_0.subtitleZh: 如需认领，请前往失物招领。

library_story_library_backpack_evicted_0.speaker: system
library_story_library_backpack_evicted_0.subtitleZh: 纸条上的这句话已经留了三天。

library_story_library_friend_contacted_0.speaker: system
library_story_library_friend_contacted_0.subtitleZh: 先查签到记录。能修改吗？

library_story_library_friend_contacted_0.speaker: seat022
library_story_library_friend_contacted_0.subtitleZh: 查完了。签到记录离开了原页面。

library_story_library_friend_contacted_0.speaker: seat022
library_story_library_friend_contacted_0.subtitleZh: 它夹在一张纸条里，记录停在 07:55。

library_story_library_friend_contacted_1.speaker: seat022
library_story_library_friend_contacted_1.subtitleZh: 它不在浅色操作能看见的位置。

library_story_library_friend_contacted_1.speaker: seat022
library_story_library_friend_contacted_1.subtitleZh: 切到深色观察，能看见纸条留下的痕迹。

library_story_library_friend_contacted_1.speaker: seat022
library_story_library_friend_contacted_1.subtitleZh: 这是它在系统里的名称。

library_story_library_friend_contacted_1.speaker: system
library_story_library_friend_contacted_1.subtitleZh: 先追痕迹，别让纸条离开视野。

library_story_library_friend_contacted_2.speaker: system
library_story_library_friend_contacted_2.subtitleZh: 它把原来的话留在纸条上了。

c3_canteen_queue_system.speaker: system
c3_canteen_queue_system.voiceTextEn: Maybe it only came to experience the queue. Many things end up queuing in a cafeteria.
c3_canteen_queue_system.subtitleZh: 系统：它可能只是来体验一下排队，很多东西在食堂都会排队。

c3_canteen_labor_system.speaker: system
c3_canteen_labor_system.voiceTextEn: Because you need money, and they need labor.
c3_canteen_labor_system.subtitleZh: 系统：因为你现在需要钱，而它们需要劳动力。

c3_canteen_bun_system.speaker: system
c3_canteen_bun_system.voiceTextEn: That does not look like something a paper slip would eat. Admittedly, paper should not eat at all.
c3_canteen_bun_system.subtitleZh: 系统：它看起来不像纸条会吃的东西，虽然纸条也不该吃东西。

c3_canteen_breakfast_system.speaker: system
c3_canteen_breakfast_system.voiceTextEn: No. It is merely a disappointingly real breakfast.
c3_canteen_breakfast_system.subtitleZh: 系统：不是，是一份比较真实的早饭。

c3_canteen_paper_chicken_system.speaker: system
c3_canteen_paper_chicken_system.voiceTextEn: Paper-wrapped chicken. At least the first word is suspicious.
c3_canteen_paper_chicken_system.subtitleZh: 系统：纸包鸡。我知道的至少前两个字很有嫌疑。

c3_canteen_packaging_system.speaker: system
c3_canteen_packaging_system.voiceTextEn: One clue. The chicken is only packaging.
c3_canteen_packaging_system.subtitleZh: 系统：一份线索。鸡只是包装。

c3_canteen_cold_clue_system.speaker: system
c3_canteen_cold_clue_system.voiceTextEn: The congee is hot. The clue is cold.
c3_canteen_cold_clue_system.subtitleZh: 系统：这份粥很热，但线索很冷。

c3_canteen_worldview_system.speaker: system
c3_canteen_worldview_system.voiceTextEn: Please do not expand the worldbuilding.
c3_canteen_worldview_system.subtitleZh: 系统：请不要拓展世界观。

c3_canteen_paper_impact_narrator.speaker: narrator
c3_canteen_paper_impact_narrator.voiceTextEn: The paper crashes back into the cafeteria and sheds a flicker of blue light.
c3_canteen_paper_impact_narrator.subtitleZh: 纸条撞回食堂，掉下一点蓝光。

c3_canteen_paper_angry_narrator.speaker: narrator
c3_canteen_paper_angry_narrator.voiceTextEn: The paper is getting desperate. It has stopped respecting the pickup procedure.
c3_canteen_paper_angry_narrator.subtitleZh: 纸条急了，它开始不尊重取餐流程。

c3_canteen_self_service_system.speaker: system
c3_canteen_self_service_system.voiceTextEn: Self-service has advanced too far. I am mildly concerned.
c3_canteen_self_service_system.subtitleZh: 系统：自助服务发展到这一步，我有点害怕。

c3_bike_escape_narrator.speaker: narrator
c3_bike_escape_narrator.voiceTextEn: The paper flees along the main road.

c3_bike_human_speed_system.speaker: system
c3_bike_human_speed_system.voiceTextEn: You are moving at the speed of a human who skipped breakfast.
c3_bike_human_speed_system.subtitleZh: 系统：你正在以“没吃早饭的人类速度”移动。

c3_bike_no_money_system.speaker: system
c3_bike_no_money_system.voiceTextEn: That sentence occurs far too often in this game.
c3_bike_no_money_system.subtitleZh: 系统：这句话在本游戏里出现频率太高了。

c3_theater_logic_system.speaker: system
c3_theater_logic_system.voiceTextEn: They changed the running order. The printed program may be out of date.
c3_theater_logic_system.subtitleZh: 系统：台上的顺序改过，印刷版未必跟得上。

c3_theater_substitute_system.speaker: system
c3_theater_substitute_system.voiceTextEn: The substitute has a serial number. The program says nothing about where the original went.
c3_theater_substitute_system.subtitleZh: 系统：替身有编号。原件去向不在节目单里。

c3_qizhen_no_trail_system.speaker: system
c3_qizhen_no_trail_system.voiceTextEn: No idea. This time it left no paper scraps along the road.
c3_qizhen_no_trail_system.subtitleZh: 系统：不知道。它这次没有沿路掉纸屑。

c3_qizhen_forum_system.speaker: system
c3_qizhen_forum_system.voiceTextEn: Use the old method. Ask the campus forum.
c3_qizhen_forum_system.subtitleZh: 系统：老办法，发个论坛问问。

c3_qizhen_cc98_system.speaker: system
c3_qizhen_cc98_system.voiceTextEn: CC98 has provided a highly precise range: not the restroom.
c3_qizhen_cc98_system.subtitleZh: 系统：CC98 提供了一个非常精确的范围：不是厕所。

c3_qizhen_catalog_system.speaker: system
c3_qizhen_catalog_system.voiceTextEn: It means the paper is currently more artistic than we are.
c3_qizhen_catalog_system.subtitleZh: 系统：意思是它现在比我们更艺术。

c3_qizhen_map_system.speaker: system
c3_qizhen_map_system.voiceTextEn: Congratulations. You have completed a campus-scale guessing game.
c3_qizhen_map_system.subtitleZh: 系统：恭喜，你完成了一次校园级猜谜。

c3_qizhen_reflection_system.speaker: system
c3_qizhen_reflection_system.voiceTextEn: More precisely, it is inside the reflection.
c3_qizhen_reflection_system.subtitleZh: 系统：准确来说，是在倒影里。

c3_qizhen_swimming_system.speaker: system
c3_qizhen_swimming_system.voiceTextEn: For someone who cannot swim, the difference is substantial.
c3_qizhen_swimming_system.subtitleZh: 系统：对不会游泳的人来说区别很大。

c3_qizhen_sign_system.speaker: system
c3_qizhen_sign_system.voiceTextEn: Should there not be a sign around here to point us somewhere?
c3_qizhen_sign_system.subtitleZh: 系统：通常这里不应该有给我们指指路的牌子吗？

c3_qizhen_hiding_system.speaker: system
c3_qizhen_hiding_system.voiceTextEn: So this is where it is hiding. Hah.
c3_qizhen_hiding_system.subtitleZh: 系统：这就是它躲藏的地方，哈

c3_qizhen_display_system.speaker: system
c3_qizhen_display_system.voiceTextEn: Hang it somewhere public. Let everyone see it.
c3_qizhen_display_system.subtitleZh: 系统：把它挂到哪里去，让大家看看！

c3_qizhen_ego_system.speaker: system
c3_qizhen_ego_system.voiceTextEn: Because it cannot tolerate someone else escaping in its place.
c3_qizhen_ego_system.subtitleZh: 系统：因为它不能接受别人替它逃跑。

c3_qizhen_atmosphere_system.speaker: system
c3_qizhen_atmosphere_system.voiceTextEn: You have only made the lake more atmospheric.
c3_qizhen_atmosphere_system.subtitleZh: 系统：你只是让湖更有氛围了。

c3_qizhen_taunt_system.speaker: system
c3_qizhen_taunt_system.voiceTextEn: It is still mocking your reflection.
c3_qizhen_taunt_system.subtitleZh: 系统：还在嘲笑你的倒影。

c3_qizhen_release_narrator.speaker: narrator
c3_qizhen_release_narrator.voiceTextEn: The paper springs out of the lake reflection and skims along the ground.
c3_qizhen_release_narrator.subtitleZh: 纸条从湖面倒影弹出来，贴着地面飞。

c3_qizhen_now_system.speaker: system
c3_qizhen_now_system.voiceTextEn: Now! It is back in the light layer!
c3_qizhen_now_system.subtitleZh: 系统：现在！它回到浅色模式了！

ch4_prologue_narrator_01.speaker: narrator
ch4_prologue_narrator_01.voiceTextEn: The lake did not keep it. The night wind carried it into the teaching building that was still lit.
ch4_prologue_narrator_01.subtitleZh: 湖面没有留下它。夜风把它送进了仍然亮着灯的教学楼。

ch4_prologue_cleaner_01.speaker: cleaner
ch4_prologue_cleaner_01.voiceTextEn: Careful, I just mopped. That paper went inside.
ch4_prologue_cleaner_01.subtitleZh: 小心，刚拖过。那张纸往里去了。

ch4_prologue_guard_01.speaker: guard
ch4_prologue_guard_01.voiceTextEn: The North Teaching Building is closing. Please pack up.
ch4_prologue_guard_01.subtitleZh: 同学，北教要清楼了，请收好东西。
